subject: Architecture
title: Big Ben: The Clock That Named a Tower
description: A quick win: understand Big Ben: The Clock That Named a Tower.

hook.text: Big Ben is not the tower. It's the name of the 13-ton bell inside it.

buildup.text: The clock's four faces are 23 feet wide. The minute hands are 14 feet long.

discovery.text: The clock has kept accurate time since 1859, corrected by adding or removing old pennies from the pendulum.

twist.text: The first bell cracked during testing. It was recast, cracked again, and has chimed with that crack ever since.

climax.text: The tower's official name was changed to Elizabeth Tower in 2012, but nobody uses it.

punchline.text: A cracked bell with the wrong name. London wouldn't have it any other way.

quiz.question: What does the name 'Big Ben' actually refer to?
